conviction_note: The fundamentals lean to a Q3 revenue miss and pressure on the $150-180M FY guide: Teal missed the Gauntlet II leaderboard, which removes the $14-28M of Q3 Drone Dominance revenue management floated, and no order of size was announced between Aug 6 and Nov 16. Against that, the stock is already -21% in 5 days and -79% from its high, short interest is 25.5% of shares out with 6.3 days to cover, calls are bid (skew -6.8), and the Q2 revenue miss was bought +6.2%. So p_up sits at 45, not lower, on an abs move of 13 (implied 11.6, scaled up for a likely guide change). The findings sum to -0.5, smaller than the scaled -1.3, because the squeeze finding is sized at full value on its own.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus ~$38.8M-$40.7M with EPS about -$0.20 to -$0.21: Earnings Whispers preview $38.8M / -$0.20 (https://finviz.com/news/420290/red-cat-needs-a-near-doubling-of-revenue-to-prove-its-back-half-bet-is-real, 2026-11-10), Chartmill $40.3M / -$0.21 (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/1RCAT.MI/estimates), Benzinga $40.7M Q3 and $73.6M Q4 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/RCAT/earnings-forecasts). Company guide: FY2026 revenue $150-180M, reaffirmed 2026-08-06, with H1 at $35.7M, so H2 must be >$114M (https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/red-cat-holdings-earnings-call-signals-high-growth-ramp). FY consensus is ~$150-157M, at the bottom of the guide. The estimate sources agree within ~5%.
positioning_check: Short interest 38,905,455 shares at the 2026-10-30 settlement, 6.32 days to cover, up from 30.4M on 2026-08-14 and rising through every settlement since. That is about 25.5% of 152.71M shares outstanding (https://equibles.com/stocks/rcat/shortinterest), a crowded short. Baseline skew is -6.81 vol points: calls are bid over puts ('upside paid'). Put/call OI is 0.70. Spot $3.565 is -20.8% over 5 days, -23.8% over 20 days, -79.5% from the 52-week high and 4.7% above the 52-week low. ATM spread is 35% of mid, so the 11.58% event-implied move is indicative only.

findings.finding: Teal Drones (Red Cat) did not place on either Gauntlet II leaderboard; DefenseScoop's 2026-09-18 results list it among 'other close quarters participants (not on leaderboard)'. On the 2026-08-06 Q2 call the CEO said Drone Dominance 'could be $14 million to $28 million just in Q3 for us', and Teal was also absent from the 11 Gauntlet I order winners. So the Q3 Drone Dominance revenue management pointed to is most likely near zero, against a Q3 consensus of $38.8-40.7M that needs a near doubling from Q2's $20.2M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue of $20.2M missed the $22.65M consensus, and the stock still rose +6.23% (baseline, 2026-08-06). The Q3 2025 print, a miss with a cut 2025 outlook, fell about 10% (https://www.itiger.com/news/1199534733). Revenue misses on this name have gone both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock fell from about $6.5 in September to $3.57. But consensus Q3 revenue still sits at $38.8-40.7M, nearly double Q2. If the market had fully removed the Drone Dominance contribution, Q3 estimates would sit nearer $25-30M and the Earnings Whispers preview would not call the DD contribution a 'key indicator'. Net of the rest of the company: Army SRR, the NSPA and Japan international orders, Blue Ops first revenue and $50-80M of ready-to-ship inventory could fill part of the gap.
findings.independence: The CEO quote is in the Q2 call summary (https://www.webull.com/news/15398435668059136, 2026-08-07). The Gauntlet I winners list, which excludes Teal, is a separate document (https://www.defensedaily.com/drone-dominance-program-selects-11-finalists-for-potential-orders-after-first-gauntlet/unmanned-systems/). The Earnings Whispers preview also names DD's $14-28M as the key Q3 swing (https://finviz.com/news/420290/red-cat-needs-a-near-doubling-of-revenue-to-prove-its-back-half-bet-is-real).

findings.finding: Between the 2026-08-06 Q2 release and 2026-11-16, Red Cat's IR page carries no order or contract-award release of any size. It shows partnerships, a brand relaunch, a Blue Ops product launch and the Steyr bid. The last order release was a $2.49M USAF Black Widow order on 2026-07-30, delivered by 2026-08-24. On the Q2 call management said contracts would close 'in the coming weeks' and promised more contract announcements through September. Holding the $150-180M FY guide needs more than $114M of H2 revenue. Red Cat cut its FY2025 outlook at the same Q3 print last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: outlook cut, stock down about 10-12% (https://www.itiger.com/news/1199534733). In January 2026 Red Cat pre-released FY2025 revenue before the open and rose +9.38% (baseline 2026-01-13 bmo). No pre-release came this quarter.
findings.source_date: 2026-11-16 (page listing releases 2026-08-10 to 2026-11-02; page 2 lists through 2026-07-30)
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus FY revenue (~$150-157M) still sits at or inside the guide, and Q4 consensus is $73.6M. A market that had priced a guide cut would carry Street FY numbers below $150M. This finding rests on an absence (no announced orders), so it is an inference: Army task orders can be placed without a company PR.
findings.independence: The Earnings Whispers preview flags 'slower Army procurement after a leadership change' and the precedent of last year's Q3 cut (https://finviz.com/news/420290/red-cat-needs-a-near-doubling-of-revenue-to-prove-its-back-half-bet-is-real). The Q2 call summary notes a new team at the Huntsville PM UAS office (https://www.webull.com/news/15398435668059136). It shares the bar with finding 1, but rests on different documents.

findings.finding: Positioning: 38.9M shares are short (25.5% of 152.7M shares out), 6.32 days to cover at the 2026-10-30 settlement and rising every settlement since August. The stock is -20.8% over the 5 sessions into the print and 4.7% above its 52-week low, and the option skew is -6.8 vol points (calls bid). An in-line quarter, a held guide, or an order or backlog disclosure on the call would meet a crowded short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 revenue miss still closed +6.23% (baseline). Three of four baseline reactions were up.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is visible, but the squeeze is conditional on the print. The option market leans to upside (skew -6.8), consistent with this; the -21% 5-day slide into the print means sellers have already been active.
findings.independence: Baseline skew -6.81 and 'upside paid' (sealed baseline). Earnings Whispers preview: bearish sentiment up to 46.4% from 29.7% (https://finviz.com/news/420290/red-cat-needs-a-near-doubling-of-revenue-to-prove-its-back-half-bet-is-real).

findings.finding: Red Cat committed to a cash tender for Steyr Motors at EUR 39.00 for all 5,251,261 shares, about EUR 204.8M (~$238M). The 8-K was filed 2026-10-23 and names no financing source. Cash was $325.6M at June 30, against Q2 adjusted EBITDA of -$31.8M, so a full take-up leaves thin cash and the financing plan is a question for the call. On the other side, the money buys the supplier of the V7 boat engine (Blue Ops vertical integration), and the stock rose about 8% on the announcement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announcement day 2026-10-19: RCAT +8% intraday (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/19/red-cat-jumps-8-on-cash-offer-for-steyr-motors-aerovironment-and-kratos-edge-higher). An earlier equity offering priced at a 15% discount and the stock fell (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/why-red-cat-stock-tumbling-121101984.html, date not confirmed).
findings.why_not_priced: The deal terms are public. What is not public is the Q3 cash balance and whether a raise accompanies or follows the print; a priced raise would show as heavier put demand, and the skew shows the reverse.
findings.independence: Steyr's own ad hoc release (https://ir.steyr-motors.com/en/finanzmitteilungen/ad-hoc-en/). Q2 cash and EBITDA come from the Q2 release (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/RCAT/2608065582).

findings.finding: The Earnings Whispers preview reports that first-year expectations for Blue Ops (the maritime USV unit, mass production of Variant 7 started, first revenue recorded) have been scaled back.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate history; Blue Ops first revenue came with the Q2 print, which rose +6.23%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely in the wire. It adds to the H2 gap, since Q1-call commentary had cited about $150M of potential USV sales this year.
findings.independence: The Q1 2026 call reference to ~$150M potential USV sales (https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/bt_RCAT_2026_Q1) is the earlier expectation against which the scale-back reads. It shares a document with the bar.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management said $50-80M of finished Black Widow and Hellcat drones sat in inventory ready to ship immediately when orders arrive. Inventory including prepaid was $84.8M at June 30, against $30.4M at end-2025. Any order booked late in Q3 or in Q4 could convert to revenue quickly, which supports a Q4-weighted defense of the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Management statement already public; small. If orders never arrived the same inventory becomes a write-down risk, and the analyst on the call cited a reserve ratio falling to 2% from 9%.
findings.independence: Inventory figure in the Q2 release (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/red-cat-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-07/). It shares the call document with findings 1 and 2.

findings.why_not_priced: The sales are pre-arranged and public; this is near zero by construction.
findings.independence: boerse-express mentions a Form 144 for 450,000 shares (https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/red-cat-aktie-steyr-deal-mit-haken-955730).

outside_window.finding: The Steyr tender acceptance period ends 2026-12-18; the FDI approvals (Austria, Italy, Australia, UK) are due by 2027-06-30; the minimum acceptance is 50%+1, with B&C's ~15% irrevocably committed. Closing and the cash outflow fall after the window.
Gauntlet 3 is slated about six months after Gauntlet II, so Teal's next chance at Drone Dominance orders comes in 2027.

Management presents at the Deutsche Bank Global Space and Defense Tech Summit on 2026-11-18 and the BofA Defense Technology Forum on 2026-12-03, both after the exit window closes on the 2026-11-17 close.

baseline_tension: The fundamentals point negative (likely revenue miss, guide at risk), but the skew pays for upside (-6.8), short interest is 25.5% of shares out, and the stock fell 21% in five sessions into the print. So the evidence cuts against the option market's lean, and p_up is held at 45 rather than the 35-40 the fundamentals alone would give.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short, calls-bid skew): shrank the two fundamental negatives (Gauntlet miss -2.0 to -1.2, no-orders/guide -2.0 to -1.0), and p_up rose from 42 to 45.
Rule 9 (segment net of the rest): the Gauntlet finding is sized net of Army SRR, international, Blue Ops and ready inventory, which is part of the -2.0 to -1.2 cut.
Rule 5 (absence and inference): the no-order-PR finding rests on an absence, so it was sized smaller (part of the -2.0 to -1.0).
Rule 4 (financing is a question): Steyr money buys the V7 engine supplier, and the market bought the announcement +8%; sign kept slightly negative only for the cash-runway question, -0.5 to -0.3.
Rule 1 (fact vs reaction): the Q2 revenue miss was bought +6.2%, so p_up moves toward 50 and the print_vs_bar (-15%) is allowed to diverge from the small expected move.

Rule 6 (bar): consensus is sourced to three estimate providers within ~5%, plus the company guide, so no cap applied. CEO 10b5-1 sales trimmed -0.2 to -0.1 and Blue Ops scale-back -0.5 to -0.4 as largely in the wire.
